d: The Knicks defeated the Trail Blazers, 97-96 tonight in New York. Jalen Brunson contributed a team-high 30 points to go with 7 rebounds 6 three pointers and 5 assists, with Landry Shamet of the Knicks adding an additional 20 points (7-14 FG, 6-10 3P)in the game. Donovan Clingan finished with a team-high 22 points along with 13 rebounds for the Trail Blazers in the losing effort. The Knicks improve their record to 10-6 with the win, while the Trail Blazers fall to 10-6 for the season.
